metadata.hardware_requirements: 'computing server with NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650 (3.6 GHz, 6 cores)'

nodes_source.source_quote: The data used to support the results of this study are available from the corresponding author upon request.
nodes_source.description: Real-world traffic video data and traffic volumes from the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao in Shandong, China, collected from 7:50 a.m. to 9:00 a.m.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: Data availability statement explicitly states access is upon request from the corresponding author, with no public link provided.

nodes_process.source_quote: The proposed method is evaluated in SUMO, an open-source microscopic traffic simulator [31]... calibrated based on empirical data.
nodes_process.description: Set up the SUMO simulation environment for the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao, calibrated using empirical traffic data from 7:50 a.m. to 9:00 a.m.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, tool named, all key simulation parameters stated.

nodes_process.node_name: Video Frame Preprocessing and State Representation
nodes_process.source_quote: Three consecutive frames of the traffic video in the controlled area are needed... After zooming and down-sampling, the size of one observation is 4 x 512 in pixels.
nodes_process.description: Extract vehicle locations from raw images to form position matrices. Stack three consecutive frames and apply zooming and down-sampling to create a 4x512 pixel observation state.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, parameters stated, but specific image processing tool not named.

nodes_process.source_quote: consists of three convolutional neural network (CNN) layers and one full connection (FC) layer for each output layer.
nodes_process.description: Construct a deep Q-network with three CNN layers and fully connected layers for multitask learning (predicting Q-value, mean speed, and queue length simultaneously).
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, detailed architecture parameters stated, but deep learning framework not named.

nodes_process.source_quote: The Q-network is trained in 10^6 training frames... The gradient-based algorithm Adam [28] is used to update wi
nodes_process.description: Train the Q-network using Deep Q-learning with experience replay and a target network. Uses Adam optimizer and an epsilon-greedy strategy.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, optimizer named, extensive hyperparameters provided in Table 1.

nodes_process.source_quote: each scenario is evaluated in 20 simulation experiments... For comparative purposes, two scenarios are also considered... no control... PI-ALINEA
nodes_process.description: Evaluate the trained DRL agent against no-control and PI-ALINEA baselines across 20 simulation experiments with different random seeds.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, tool named, all required baseline and evaluation parameters stated.

nodes_process.source_quote: A perturbation analysis is conducted to evaluate the impact of information contained in video data... the control area is divided into eight subareas.
nodes_process.description: Divide the control area into eight subareas and systematically remove information from each subarea to evaluate its impact on travel time over 20 simulation experiments.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, tool named, perturbation parameters explicitly stated.

nodes_sink.source_quote: The training process, presented in Figure 8, can be finished in less than 24 hours on a computing server
nodes_sink.description: Convergence curves for episode reward and mean travel time during the training process of the deep Q-network.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Hyperparameters and simulator (SUMO) are specified, but the source code and empirical input data are not publicly available (data available upon request).

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 9 presents the Q1 (25%), Q2 (50%), and Q3 (75%) of the travel times in the mainline for three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: Vehicle travel times in the mainline over time for no control, PI-ALINEA, and Deep RL scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Simulation setup is detailed, but lack of open code and exact empirical input data limits full independent reconstruction.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Table 2 presents mean vehicle travel times in 20 simulation experiments.
nodes_sink.description: Mean travel times in 20 simulation experiments comparing No controls, PI-ALINEA, and DRL methods.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Clear experimental design with 20 random seeds, but exact seeds, code, and empirical data are unavailable.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 10 presents the temporal-spatial distribution of the mean speeds along the mainline.
nodes_sink.description: Temporal-spatial distribution of speed in no-control, PI-ALINEA, and DRL scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Visualizes simulation outputs clearly, but relies on closed code and empirical data available only upon request.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 11 presents the Q1, Q2, and Q3 of the queue lengths at the on-ramp in three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: Queue length at the on-ramp over time for no control, PI-ALINEA, and Deep RL.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Clear aggregation of simulation outputs, but upstream code and data are not public.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 12 presents the mean queue lengths at the on-ramp and the red ratios... in each simulation for the two ramp metering methods.
nodes_sink.description: Relationship of queue length and red ratio for PI-ALINEA and DRL.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Scatter plots of simulation metrics are well-described, but depend on unavailable code and data.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 13 presents the queue lengths at the on-ramp and the occupancy downstream of the merging area for the two ramp metering methods.
nodes_sink.description: Queue length and occupancy over time for PI-ALINEA and DRL.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Time series plots are clear, but upstream simulation code and empirical data are not provided.

nodes_sink.source_quote: The better performance of the proposed DRL method is further revealed when considering traffic flows downstream of the merge area, which is demonstrated in Figure 14.
nodes_sink.description: Downstream volume in three scenarios (No control, PI-ALINEA, Deep RL) over time.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Box plots of downstream volumes are well-described, but depend on unavailable code and data.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 16 presents the box plot of travel time when the information of different subareas is removed, and the baseline is the result of experiments that take original data as input.
nodes_sink.description: Travel time with perturbed input data, showing the impact of removing information from different subareas.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Perturbation analysis is described, but exact implementation details, code, and data are missing.
